new_packages.label: לִילִית וְקִלְקוּל הָרְאוּת
new_packages.label_en: Lilit and the Corruption of Sight

bechina_connections.proof: אִמָּא דְּעֵרֶב רַב הִיא לִילִית שֶׁהִיא מְיַלֶּלֶת תָּמִיד
bechina_connections.type: identity statement — the mother's nature IS the essential nature of her children; they wail because she wails

bechina_connections.proof: יְנִיקָתָם מִבְּחִינַת: וְעֵינֵי לֵאָה רַכּוֹת, מִבְּחִינַת קִלְקוּל הָרְאוּת
בִּבְחִינַת מְאֹרֹת חָסֵר... דָּא לִילִית (ת"ז תיקון מד דף עט:)
bechina_connections.type: explicit identity equation from Tikunei Zohar, quoted as authoritative

bechina_connections.proof: The chain: יניקתם (of those drawn to wailing melodies) ← ועיני לאה רכות ← קלקול הראות ← מאורות חסר ← לילית. The corruption of sight IS the domain of Lilit (defective light = Lilit).
bechina_connections.type: composite bechina via chain within the same passage

new_packages.reason: All six nodes share the same essential nature: they are expressions of the domain of corrupted/defective light, dark wailing, and Lilit's influence. The chain of bechina statements in the Torah text explicitly links them: the wicked who sing wailing melodies are the souls of the Erev Rav, whose mother Lilit constantly wails. Their sustenance comes from the defective sight represented by Leah's soft eyes (= corruption of sight). The defective spelling of 'luminaries' (מאורות חסר) IS Lilit (Tikunei Zohar). The evil melody, the wailing, the corrupted eyes, the defective luminaries, and Lilit herself are all facets of the same domain: incomplete, corrupted light/vision. This is the evil mirror of Package 1 (Shabbat = complete repair of sight): the evil package = corrupted/defective sight = Lilit.
new_packages.mirror_explanation: Package 1 (שַׁבָּת וְתִקּוּן הָרְאוּת, good) ↔ Proposed Package A (לִילִית וְקִלְקוּל הָרְאוּת, evil). The structural mirror is precise: תִּקּוּן הָרְאוּת בִּשְׁלֵמוּת (complete repair of sight) mirrors קִלְקוּל הָרְאוּת (corruption of sight). שַׁבָּת (complete light) mirrors מְאֹרֹת חָסֵר / לִילִית (defective/incomplete light).

new_packages.label: שֵׁבֶט לֵוִי וְהַנִּגּוּן
new_packages.label_en: The Tribe of Levi and Melody

bechina_connections.proof: לֵוִי שֶׁהוּא סִטְרָא דְּנִגּוּנָא (זוהר שמות דף יט)
bechina_connections.type: explicit identity statement — Levi IS the melody-dimension

bechina_connections.proof: וְעִקַּר הַנִּגּוּן הוּא מִבְּחִינַת שֵׁבֶט לֵוִי שֶׁהָיוּ מְנַצְּחִים בְּשִׁיר
bechina_connections.type: explicit bechina — the essence of melody (עיקר הניגון) IS from the bechina of Shevet Levi

new_packages.reason: Shevet Levi, the sitra d'niguna (melody-dimension), and melody itself are three expressions of the same thematic domain: the structural/spiritual source of music. The Rebbe states 'עִקַּר הַנִּגּוּן הוּא מִבְּחִינַת שֵׁבֶט לֵוִי' (the essence of melody IS from the bechina of Shevet Levi) and 'לֵוִי שֶׁהוּא סִטְרָא דְּנִגּוּנָא' (Levi is the side of melody). These are mutually illuminating bechina identities: melody = Levi-dimension = sitra d'niguna. This package is NEUTRAL because Levi/melody originates from Leah's side (the same source as the corrupted melodies) yet represents the holy directing of song. The same domain of melody can be captured by evil (wailing/Lilit) or expressed in holiness (Shevet Levi's Temple song). The neutral package represents the structural-domain of music before polarity is assigned.
new_packages.note: The 'ניגון' node is proposed as a standalone entry — distinct from 'ניגוני יללה' (the evil wailing melodies in proposed Package A). Melody per se is the neutral structure; the evil melodies are its corrupted manifestation.

observations:
Torah #226 contains three clearly distinguishable bechina clusters, each forming an independent thematic domain:

1. GOOD (Package 1 — already in dataset): שַׁבָּת ↔ תִּקּוּן הָרְאוּת בִּשְׁלֵמוּת. One bechina edge. Shabbat = complete repair of sight.

2. EVIL (Proposed Package A — entirely absent from dataset): A cluster of 5–6 concepts forming the domain of corrupted sight, Lilit, and wailing. The bechina connections are explicit and multiple:
   - רשעים המזמרים ניגוני יללה הם בחינת נשמת ערב רב
   - אמא דערב רב היא לילית (identity)
   - יניקתם מבחינת ועיני לאה רכות, מבחינת קלקול הראות
   - מאורות חסר דא לילית (Tikunei Zohar)
   This is a tight, well-connected cluster of 6 nodes with 4 direct bechina connections among them, clearly forming an independent evil domain.

3. NEUTRAL/MEDIAL (Proposed Package B — absent from dataset): שבט לוי ↔ סטרא דניגונא ↔ ניגון. Three nodes linked by explicit bechina statements. Levi IS the side of melody; the essence of melody IS from Shevet Levi's domain. This is a structural/neutral cluster representing music as an independent domain.

The threshold for new package proposals (3+ concepts connected by explicit bechina language forming an independent domain) is clearly met by both proposed packages. The evil cluster (Package A) has 6 nodes and 4 explicit bechina connections. The melody cluster (Package B) has 3 nodes and 2 explicit bechina connections.

The Torah's overall structure maps as follows:
[Proposed Evil Package A: corrupted sight/Lilit/Erev Rav] ←eitza source of wailing melodies←
[Proposed Neutral Package B: Levi/melody] ← the holy source of melody, which can be drawn toward evil
↓ eitza (on Shabbat, the evil melodies are elevated)
[Package 1: Shabbat/complete sight] ← the good resolution

The good/evil mirror is structurally precise: תִּקּוּן הָרְאוּת בִּשְׁלֵמוּת (Package 1) mirrors קִלְקוּל הָרְאוּת (Proposed Package A); Shabbat/complete luminaries mirror Lilit/defective luminaries.
